title: hieracium bifidum subsp. coriifolium
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. coriifolium, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
